chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdullah عليه السلام was asked about the child of zina: may he be bought, sold, or employed for service?
He عليه السلام said: "Yes, except for a foundling girl, for she is not to be bought."

key_terms.لَقِيطَةً: a foundling girl, abandoned and taken up by others
key_terms.يُسْتَخْدَمُ: to be used for service or employed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on buying or selling a child born of zina or a foundling girl in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the permissibility of buying, selling, or employing a child born of zina. It makes an exception for a foundling girl, stating that she may not be purchased, indicating a distinct legal status in such a case.
